question: What result follows from placing these beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha?
premises: These items beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha are to be placed.
The placement is prescribed as a ritual act.
All mantras become pleased as a consequence.
inference: Therefore placing these beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha causes all mantras to become pleased.
plain_english: One should place these beginning with Śrīkaṇṭha; then all the mantras become pleased.
